description: For purchase request, this checklist records business justification, specification, alternatives, total cost, recurring obligation, sourcing path, and budget availability. Its supporting evidence includes quotes, budget report, technical review, supplier record, conflict disclosure, contract reference, and approval evidence.

use_case: Use the checklist during internal purchase request and authorization when the purchase request record must identify requester, department, supplier, goods or services, quantity, needed-by date, location, and accounting dimensions. Complete the applicable handoff for purchase-order reference, committed amount, receiving owner, invoice instructions, asset tagging, and request closure.
